messages:
Eli: Quick thread to resolve billing taxonomy + minimal IAM for the AWS/GCP/Azure storefront listing. We keep hitting edge cases with promo coupons vs metered addons. Need clear owners and a reconciliation note for finance.
Tam: I can take billing taxonomy & finance touchpoint. We need 1) subscription SKUs, 2) metered addons, 3) promo mapping doc.
Rhea: I'll own packaging copy and public bullets. Need to know if we expose "hourly" pricing or keep it hidden behind CTA.
Marcus: Eng: I will draft the minimal cross-account IAM snippets and a short publisher README. Also will add telemetry tags we need on the provisioning call for billing reconciliation.
Diego: Legal: will add the privacy + retention blurb and check model attribution language. Also confirm promo terms for marketplace coupons (legal side).
marketplace-bot: :pushpin: Preflight checklist v5 updated: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/checklists/preflight-v5.md
Tam: Billing approach proposal: public listing shows subscription SKUs only. Metered addons are listed as "Add-on metering available" with CTA to contact sales. Promo coupons applied in-cloud for subscription SKUs; metered discounts must route to Redwood billing via partner invoice mapping. I'll write a one-pager.
Eli: That sounds safe. Finance needs the telemetry key name so they can reconcile usage to couponed customers.
Marcus: Telemetry: add header X-RWD-MKT-TRIAL-ID and resource tag marketplace_offer_id in provisioning. Will include snippet and example event payload.
Rhea: Packaging: I'll prepare 3 bullets per SKU and keep pricing summary generic. Include a short "what's included" list for each SKU.
Tam: Action owners:
- Tam: billing taxonomy doc + finance sync (48h)
- Marcus: IAM snippets + telemetry sample (48h)
- Rhea: SKU copy + asset README (24h)
- Diego: legal promo terms + privacy blurb (72h)
Eli: Marcus can you paste minimal AWS trust policy we want publishers to create?
Marcus: AWS trust policy (example):
```json
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{ "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT:role/RedwoodPublisher"}, "Action": "sts:AssumeRole" }] }
```
Diego: Legal note: include a short sentence in the listing about "promo coupon applicability" and a link to full terms. I'll add the required sentence and a checkbox in the manifest.
Rhea: Where do we upload hero assets? Shared drive or do we put directly into publisher portal?
Eli: Shared drive first: /Shared/marketplace/onboards/1799999555/assets. Rhea upload there and Marcus will pull for validation.
Marcus: GCP service account snippet to include in manifest:
resource "google_service_account" "pub_sa" { account_id = "rwd-pub-sa" }
# Grant roles/storage.objectViewer, roles/compute.viewer

Marcus: Also note: telemetry header must be present on billing-affecting calls or finance can't tie discounts. We'll add a preflight checkbox for telemetry test.
Tam: Finance sync: I'll loop in Priya from Finance and schedule a 30-min review after the docs are drafted.
Diego: Legal will need to review the final SKU names before we publish (avoid "Enterprise" as a public SKU label).
Rhea: Proposed SKU IDs: RWD-CORE, RWD-SCALE, RWD-PRO-TR. Any objections?
Diego: Replace PRO with ADV if it helps reduce enterprise connotations: RWD-ADV-TR is fine.
Tam: One more billing edge-case: if a customer redeems coupon and then switches region (billing account differences), we need a clear note in the billing doc. I'll call that out.
Eli: Let's do a 20-min sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to final-check the taxonomy and IAM snippets. Marcus, can you join?
Marcus: Yep.
Diego: I'll join for legal bits.
marketplace-bot: :warning: Compliance reminder: upload signed privacy_manifest.pdf to the shared folder before requesting staging publish.
Eli: Thanks team 4aa I'll post the shared folder link when created and attach the initial SKU CSV.
